design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value (PV1SCIE) for modeling, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information indicating that multilevel modeling or any clustering methods were used, suggesting that student-level models were employed without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and appears to rely solely on internal validation techniques.
